name: Front Door
summary: Azure Front Door: global HTTPS entry point with a CDN cache, health-probed origin failover and managed TLS certificates for custom domains.
useWhen: You need a global, low-latency entry point with caching in front of a web app or API
You need automatic failover between origins in different regions
avoidWhen: You need WAF protection today (not covered by this module; the Front Door-specific WAF policy resource is a different type from this repo's App Gateway waf-policy module)
Regional-only ingress is enough (Application Gateway is simpler and cheaper for a single-region deployment)
